# Complex synthetic Boomi X12 Order-to-Cash corpus

Migration-test package covering inbound X12 850, canonical JSON transformation and enrichment, OMS submission, X12 997 and 855 responses, plus outbound 856 and 810 flows. It includes AS2/SFTP partner metadata, archive behavior, duplicate detection, retries, dead-letter handling, mapping rules, profiles, samples, expected output, and tests.

This is synthetic and safe for tooling tests. It is not claimed to be an importable native Boomi AtomSphere package.
